seo.title: AI Engineer
seo.description: Background, skills and passions of Adrián Ortiz Ramírez, AI engineer and computer scientist based in Madrid.

hero.title: ABOUT ME
hero.subtitle: Get to know more about my background, skills, and passions

photo.alt: Adrián Ortiz Ramírez in a white shirt, standing in a green wheat field blown by the wind

story.p1: Before the projects and the dates, I want to tell you how I see things. My name is Adrián, I am an AI engineer, and I like minimalism: clear, direct solutions with nothing that is not needed. I think good technology should not get in the way; it simply works and lets people focus on what matters.
story.p2: That is why I have always been drawn to process automation. I enjoy taking a messy, manual process and turning it into a clear one that runs on its own. With every challenge I aim for the same thing: to understand it fully and build a solution that looks simple, even if it was not.
story.catAlt: Lady, a grey, white and ginger cat, sitting on a window ledge in front of a garden and looking up
story.p3: I believe the most interesting problems are found where the physical world meets the world of data. Almost everything we can touch, see or hear leaves a trace that can be measured, and that trace, read well, says more than it seems: a voice, a field of crops, the rhythm of a process. With automation, that knowledge does not stay on a screen: it turns into better decisions, time saved and better care for people.
story.p4: I also believe research matters, and a great deal: it is how what we learn stops belonging to a single person and gets shared, tested and put to use by others. I still have a lot to learn, but I have been doing my bit through publications, articles, talks and scientific posters, and each of them has taught me something new.

currently.title: Currently
currently.text: I am developing deep learning models within an EU initiative to analyse voice biomarkers and predict the risk of neurodegenerative diseases at the presymptomatic stage (From speech to predictions @Cephalgo).

intro.name: Adrián Ortiz Ramírez
intro.p1: Hi there! I’m Adrián and I’m currently working as an AI engineer. Lately, I’ve been focused on bringing Speech Emotion Recognition, AI Compliance Evaluation and Psychology AI into the real world.
intro.p2: I love making things look simple.
